allreduce_grads: allreduce gradients across GPUs for a list of model parameters with optional coalescing
reduce_mean: reduce a tensor to its mean value across all GPUs in a distributed setting
obj2tensor: serialize a picklable Python object into a torch ByteTensor on a specified device
tensor2obj: deserialize a torch ByteTensor back into its original picklable Python object
all_reduce_dict: apply all reduce sum or mean operation across GPUs for a Python dict of tensors
sync_random_seed: synchronize a random seed across all ranks in a distributed training group
